name: Marco
headline: Turn MSC’s booking data into journeys that get rebooked.
saw: In travel arrangements the same trips and offers usually greet every visitor, whether they are booking for the first time or coming back for another journey.

Once a guest has booked, the signal you already own is what they book, when they travel, how far in advance they plan and what they add on. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the guest receives.
Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are typically built by hand, per segment, per month. The guest who is about to stop booking this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the lapsed guest before they leave
cases.text: Churn signals per guest from booking gaps, travel dates and service contacts. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each traveller and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next trip that fits
cases.text: Next best trip and add-on per guest, based on past bookings, travel dates and what they have bought before. No more blanket mails to guests already booked on the right journey.

cases.head: Give every guest a reason to rebook
cases.text: Personal trip ideas and timed nudges by email and messages, orchestrated so each guest hears from you when a return trip is likely.
cases.kpi_label: conversion vs untargeted campaigns, Tier-1 African MNO
